title: edikt directive index (.claude/rules/governance/directive-index.yaml)
description: The hook tier's input: glob -> graded directive entries. Written ONLY by Phase B render (deterministic, sorted); read by `bin/edikt hook match` and by diff-time consumers. Deliberately non-.md so the host's rules loader and post-flight's *.md glob ignore it — this is a machine surface, not a context file. The consumer NEVER re-derives grade and never rewrites text: pinned judgment is consumed verbatim.

schema_version.description: Index contract version. A reader that does not know this version refuses the file rather than guessing its shape (fail-closed), so shape evolution is explicit.

globs.description: Map of doublestar glob -> the entries scoped to it. An EMPTY map is valid and means 'zero path-scoped directives compiled' — a measured zero. A MISSING FILE is UNMEASURED: the verb errors and the shims fail open.

propertyNames.description: Shape allowlist for glob keys — no whitespace, quotes, pipes, backslashes or newlines. Validated at render time AND re-validated by the consuming verb: the index is protected against a tampered managed region, but a consumer that assumes its own input is safe is one managed-region bypass away from being wrong.

id.description: Stable deterministic entry id: <ARTIFACT-ID>:<d|p><1-based zero-padded ordinal within the source sidecar's directives[]/prohibitions[]>. Byte-equal sidecar input yields byte-equal ids, and session dedup keys on this id — so stability is contractual, not cosmetic.

grade.description: PINNED at render time: `must` iff the source artifact is an invariant OR the text carries MUST NOT / NEVER / No exceptions; else `advisory`. Recorded per entry precisely so the hook never re-derives it — grade selects the channel (must -> deny-once bounce, advisory -> additionalContext), and a consumer that re-derived it could silently downgrade an invariant.

text.description: The compiled directive sentence verbatim from the sidecar, including its (ref: ID) tail — the payload the shim injects.

intent.description: Optional; carried through from the sidecar when present so diff-time consumers reading this index keep the intent shape without a second lookup.

falsifying_observation.description: Optional; travels with intent as a pair (extraction emits both or falls back to text).

reminders.description: The source artifact's reminders, delivered at write-touch time. Reminder aggregation re-targets HERE rather than into the ambient core, which is what lets the ambient surface drop its always-on Reminders section without the content vanishing. REQUIRED key; may be empty — an empty list is a measured zero, an absent key is an omission.
